narrative.overview: An open working surface with purposeful learning actions, readable evidence and quiet controls. Shared semantic palettes and typography unite platform-appropriate web and native layouts.
dos: Keep one useful learning action prominent.
Pair colour with words and evidence.
donts: Do not restore the V1 grid and tiny mono labels.
Do not equate accuracy with mastery.
Do not claim unverified accessibility or cross-device draft support.
